Title: Karan and the Family

Cast

1. Karan - 30 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Shalini - 62 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Ajay - 58 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Karan is asleep in bed in the ward. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "Let's do something fun today."

[After a long illness Karan passes away in his hospital bed.]

Shalini: "We will never forget you."
